The Betty and Barney Hill Case
In 1961, Betty and Barney Hill, a couple from New Hampshire, claimed they were abducted by extraterrestrials.
Under hypnosis, Betty described seeing a “star map” shown to her aboard the alien craft.
Later, she drew the map from memory, which became known as the “Hill star map.”
🌠 The Zeta Reticuli Connection
Years later (in the 1970s), an amateur astronomer named Marjorie Fish tried to match Betty’s drawing to real stars.
She concluded that the pattern lined up best with the Zeta Reticuli system in the constellation Reticulum, roughly 39 light-years from Earth.
This theory popularized the idea of “the Zeta Reticuli Incident,” and the term “Zeta Reticulans” became common in UFO circles to refer to grey-type aliens.
So yes — the drawing that linked Zeta Reticuli to alien abductions was originally made by Betty Hill after her hypnotic regression sessions.
